title: Reuse the already-created protected production auth runtime and expose bounded recovery-run evidence
acceptance: the repository owner can request bounded status on release issue 3072 without production mutation
status output is restricted to recovery workflow run ids, head SHA, run/job/step status and conclusions
no Actions environment, secret, credential, artifact contents or production logs are printed
the status path can identify the silent recovery failure before any retry is issued
production remains the existing REG.RU contour and new recurring cost remains 0 RUB
